meta.name: cobrapy
meta.description: Constraint-based metabolic modeling (COBRA). FBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling, SBML models, for systems biology and metabolic engineering analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对代谢网络进行约束性建模与通量分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要分析代谢网络、预测基因敲除或进行通量平衡分析。
copy.tagline_en: Perform constraint-based modeling and flux analysis of metabolic networks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to analyze metabolic networks, predict gene knockouts, or perform flux balance analysis.

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 能用 COBRApy 库读取、构建和保存代谢模型,并做通量平衡分析、基因敲除、培养基优化等计算,返回数值结果。
howto.when: 当你说要分析或模拟代谢模型时触发,例如加载或构建 SBML 模型、做 FBA 或基因敲除分析。

say.text: 加载 textbook 模型,跑一次 FBA,告诉我预测的生长速率。
say.note: 会返回目标函数值和各反应通量。

say.text: 对 iJO1366 做单基因敲除筛查,列出必需基因。
say.note: 会逐个敲除基因并比较生长。

say.text: 导出当前模型为 SBML,并计算最小培养基成分。
say.note: 会列出需要添加的培养基组分。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the COBRApy library to read, build, and save metabolic models, and run simulations such as flux balance analysis, gene knockout screening, and growth medium optimization, returning numeric results.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you ask to analyze or simulate metabolic models, e.g., loading/building an SBML model, running FBA, or performing gene knockout analysis.

say_en.text: Load the textbook model, run FBA, and report the predicted growth rate.
say_en.note: Returns objective value and reaction fluxes.

say_en.text: Run a single-gene deletion screen on iJO1366 and list essential genes.
say_en.note: Knocks out each gene and compares growth.

say_en.text: Export the model to SBML and compute the minimal medium.
say_en.note: Lists the medium components to add.
